title: Closing Out Waiver Coverage Financed With an Auto Loan and Entering the Refund
content:
Where a borrower on a loan of the Auto Loans line closes out the guaranteed asset protection waiver coverage financed with that loan, the cancellation is recorded, the coverage ends, and the refund owed on it is entered against the loan, so the loan's unpaid principal falls by that sum.

## The capability

`post_gap_refund_16f4decd` is the borrower's own tool for giving the instruction to close out the waiver coverage financed with their auto loan and having the refund owed on it entered against that loan. One call records the confirmed cancellation instruction as a service request of its own on the loan, ends the coverage, records today as the date it was cancelled, and posts a refund entry on the loan's activity for the amount passed in, which reduces the loan's unpaid principal by that amount. The borrower sees the cancellation recorded as confirmed, the coverage shown as no longer standing, and the refund entry dated today on the loan's activity with the principal lower by the refunded sum.

## How it is invoked

The tool is hidden and belongs to the borrower. The agent unlocks `post_gap_refund_16f4decd` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `auto_loan_id` | The reference number of the borrower's auto loan whose waiver coverage is being closed out; the servicing agent reads it from the loan record and hands it over with the tool | Id |
| `customer_id` | The reference number identifying the borrower on that loan; the servicing agent reads it from the customer profile and hands it over | Id |
| `refund_amount` | The refund entered against the loan | USD with 2 decimal places, positive and never more than the charge financed at funding, passed already rounded to the cent |

## Return

A confirmation sentence naming the loan reference number, the reference number of the recorded cancellation instruction, the new refund entry's reference number, the refunded sum in USD to the cent, and the loan's unpaid principal after the entry. Receiving that sentence means the cancellation stands recorded as confirmed, the coverage is closed out and the refund stands on the loan's activity.
